headline: Adopted closing procedures for final water and sewer invoices and approved budget transfers of $113,156.07, $200,957.51, and $159,755.15.
summary: Adopted a revised payment-processing policy and new closing procedures for final invoices. Approved budget transfers of $113,156.07, $200,957.51, and $159,755.15 to fund over expenditures in the 2025/2026 budget. Gave no recourse to 35 Wolcott Street on its request for a reduced high-water bill.
decisions: Approved the July 21, 2026 regular meeting minutes; vote was unanimous.
Approved the July 2026 department reports; vote was unanimous.
Denied the request for a reduced high-water bill at 35 Wolcott Street by giving no recourse; vote was unanimous.
Approved the revision to the department policy on processing payments; vote was unanimous.
Adopted closing procedures for calculating final invoices; vote was unanimous.
Approved budget transfers of $113,156.07, $200,957.51, and $159,755.15 to fund over expenditures in the 2025/2026 budget; vote was unanimous.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Commissioner Dunn and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the July 21, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented. Motion passed.
On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the July 2026 Department Reports as presented. Motion passed.

a. 35 Wolcott Street: Requesting discount or reduced bill on the high-water bill caused by a faulty flapper in one of his bathrooms. On motion of Commissioner Dunn and seconded; it was unanimously voted that no recourse be given to 35 Wolcott Street. Motion passed.
On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the revision on the Department Policy on Processing Payments as presented. Motion passed.
On motion of Commissioner Dunn and seconded; it was unanimously voted to adopt the proposed Closing Procedures for Calculating Final Invoices as presented. Motion passed.

On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to bring to the table and to approve the transfers to fund over expenditures in the 2025/2026 Budget as presented. Motion passed.
